integrity: The theorem is proved by explicit dimension-two trace identities and a nondegenerate alternating-form argument. The closest inspected source proves only virtual solvability in arbitrary dimension and does not state this finite-field order classification.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic and dimension two only; characteristic two and higher dimensions are not claimed. Exhaustive checks cover q=3 and q=5 only and serve as regression tests, not as the general proof.
title: Sharp \(2q\) bound for constant-characteristic-polynomial cosets in \(\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb F_q)\)
